data.heading: Polar regions
data.rubric: Polar bears in the Arctic region have thick furs.
Penguins in Antarctica have a thick layer of fat.
data.text: The large areas of the globe surrounding the North and South Poles are called Polar regions.
The South Polar region is called Antarctica.
The North Polar region is called the Arctic.
The Polar regions are very cold and dry, and so are also known as cold deserts.
Antarctica is the driest continent on Earth.
The Arctic has no land; it is entirely made of ice over the Arctic Ocean.
